title: Wallpy pack schedule (spec 2)
description: A pack's schedule.toml as JSON. One shape for every pack: an ordered list of slots, each starting at a time and lasting until the next slot starts. Semantics: spec/README.md. Rules JSON Schema can't express are listed there and enforced by the validators.

slot.description: The slots, in time order within each day. In TOML, one [[slot]] table per entry: an array, because order carries meaning and arrays keep it everywhere (JSON objects, e.g. Postgres jsonb, do not).

label.description: Optional human name shown in previews ("dawn", "night").

days.description: Days the slot applies to. Default: every day.

rotate.description: How several images share the slot. "spread" (default): the slot's duration is split evenly, in order. "every <n><m|h|d>": the image changes on a fixed interval (5m to 7d, checked by validators).

shuffle.description: Randomise the order (deterministically, see spec/README.md). Default false.

time.description: 24h clock time ("08:30") or a solar event with an optional offset ("sunrise+90m", "sunset-1h", "dusk+1h30m").

image.description: A filename inside the pack's images/ folder: no directories, so a schedule can never point outside its pack.
